description_en: Queries the IM channel list of a specified agent
description_zh: 查询指定智能体的 IM 渠道列表
name: ListAgentIMChannels

parameters.help_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:
DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
parameters.help_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en:
The IM channel status. Valid values:
CREATING: being created.
READY: ready.
UPDATING: being updated.
FAILED: failed.
DELETING: being deleted.
DELETE_FAILED: deletion failed
parameters.help_zh: IM 渠道状态。枚举值：CREATING（创建中）、READY（就绪）、UPDATING（更新中）、FAILED（失败）、DELETING（删除中）、DELETE_FAILED（删除失败）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值范围为 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。首次调用可不传；后续调用使用上一次响应返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token
